description: Validates a document against EmailImportOptions: the number of sections, the number of blocks and the block nesting depth. A host runs it on the server before saving (and the MJML importer uses the very same validator, so an import can never accept a document the save-time check rejects). Findings carry localization keys, never localized text.

members.name: Validate
members.description: Validates the document and returns every violated limit (empty when it fits).

members.name: Options
members.description: Gets the limits this validator applies.
